_meta.batch: Tadpole 04 STATEMENT (70 terminow) - kontynuacja luku Tadpole po batch_32-33 (45/245). Barwna, przygodowa opowiesc Tadpole o nocy morderstwa - 'demon' ktorego rzekomo pokonala improwizowanym oszczepem (wioslem) okazuje sie prawdopodobnie ZAMASKOWANYM CZLOWIEKIEM (skorzana maska na cala glowe, jak kominiarka, znaleziona plywajaca w wodzie, potem skradziona) - istotny trop dot. mordercy.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json (soulTalking) - 70/70 pokryte: Tadpole 47 (przybliz.), Grimoire i Sally reszta
_meta.character_voice: Tadpole: bezposrednia, potoczna, przygodowa narracja ('cos', 'tryna', 'nah', 'yup') - patrz batch_32-33.

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I remember the sub did a weird kind of [i]tilt.[/i] Dunno what it was, but anyway, it woke me up.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Pamiętam, że łódź zrobiła jakiś dziwny [i]przechył.[/i] Nie wiem co to było, ale w każdym razie mnie obudziło.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I get up and check outside - nothing. So I check the bilge.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Wstaję i sprawdzam na zewnątrz - nic. Więc sprawdzam Zęzę.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: No, but something's dripping into the water...
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Nie, ale coś kapie do wody...
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: So I head up there to check. The door's locked - I open it up.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Więc idę tam sprawdzić. Drzwi są zamknięte - otwieram je.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I go inside, and that's when I find him. Dead - [i]killed[/i], looks like.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Wchodzę do środka, i wtedy go znajduję. Martwego - [i]zabitego,[/i] wygląda na to.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I get [i]angry[/i]. I'm out for [i]revenge[/i] - I gotta find the guy who did it.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Robię się [i]wściekła.[/i] Chcę [i]zemsty[/i] - muszę znaleźć tego, kto to zrobił.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: So I run to the mess hall - [i]nobody.[/i] Climb up to the parlor - [i]nobody.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Więc biegnę do Mesy - [i]nikogo.[/i] Wspinam się do salonu - [i]nikogo.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Then I notice the hatch up to the fore deck was left open...
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Wtedy zauważam, że właz na pokład dziobowy został zostawiony otwarty...
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Someone's making an escape, I think. [i]Cowardly.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Ktoś ucieka, myślę sobie. [i]Tchórzliwie.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I go up on deck - nobody. I look across to the [i]aft[/i] deck-
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Wychodzę na pokład - nikogo. Patrzę w stronę pokładu [i]rufowego[/i]-
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Nah, there was a demon.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Nie, był tam demon.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Yup. Glowing eyes, single horn coming outta the head - like an [i]antler[/i], kind of.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Ta. Świecące oczy, jeden róg wystający z głowy - trochę jak [i]poroże.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: No idea. Alien language.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Nie mam pojęcia. Kosmiczny język.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Uh... so - [i]oh yeah[/i], there was this big green light. Not sure where it was coming from, though.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Yy... więc - [i]a tak[/i], było takie wielkie zielone światło. Nie jestem pewna, skąd dokładnie dochodziło.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: So I took one of the oars off the old rowing boat and threw it. Hard.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Więc wzięłam jedno z wioseł ze starej łódki wiosłowej i rzuciłam nim. Mocno.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I wanna be sure, so I jump off the side and swim over to the aft deck.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Chcę się upewnić, więc zeskakuję z burty i płynę w stronę pokładu rufowego.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: But nope, nothing.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Ale nie, nic.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Then I dive down past the back of the sub, to take a look around.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Potem nurkuję obok tyłu łodzi, żeby się rozejrzeć.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Did you [h]see[/h] anyone?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: [h]Widziałaś[/h] kogoś?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Did you ever [i]find[/i] the head? Of the - demon or whatever it was? You said it fell into the ocean.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Czy w ogóle [i]znalazłaś[/i] tę głowę? Demona czy czym to tam było? Mówiłaś, że wpadła do oceanu.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Nope.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Nie.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I took it back inside the submarine, left it right here in the airlock, and uh...
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Zabrałam ją z powrotem na łódź, zostawiłam właśnie tutaj, w śluzie, i yy...
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I left the airlock... told Sinthia to gather up the others and come up to the store room.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Wyszłam ze śluzy... kazałam Sinthii zebrać resztę i przyjść do magazynu.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Zephyr was in the mess hall, I told him to come too.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Zephyr był w Mesie, kazałam mu też przyjść.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: So I go to the store room... Dirk's there, with Wirman, and Sym.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Więc idę do magazynu... jest tam Dirk, z Wirmanem, i Sym.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Everyone else shows up shortly after.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Reszta pojawia się chwilę później.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: So - you all gathered at the crime scene. What happened?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Więc - wszyscy zebraliście się na miejscu zbrodni. Co się stało?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Nobody wanted to admit to [i]murder,[/i] so it was a bit of a stalemate.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Nikt nie chciał przyznać się do [i]morderstwa,[/i] więc zrobił się mały pat.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Most of the others made excuses and scurried off...
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Większość reszty wymyśliła wymówki i się rozpierzchła...
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Zephyr, Gripp and I stayed behind. I guess we were the ones who knew Magnus best.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Zephyr, Gripp i ja zostaliśmy. Chyba to my znaliśmy Magnusa najlepiej.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: So yeah, I'm tryna go back to sleep but I can't - cos now there's all these [i]footsteps[/i] outside my room.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Więc no, próbuję wrócić do snu, ale nie mogę - bo teraz są te wszystkie [i]kroki[/i] za moimi drzwiami.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Was anyone [i]in[/i] there?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Był tam [i]ktoś?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I get a closer look, and it's [i]blood[/i] - coming through the drain that connects to the room above.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Przyglądam się bliżej, i to [i]krew[/i] - płynąca przez odpływ łączący się z pokojem powyżej.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: You [i]unlocked[/i] it? How?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: [i]Odblokowałaś[/i] to? Jak?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: So [i]okay,[/i] I guess it's not really [i]locked,[/i] more like - [i]shut.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Więc [i]okej,[/i] chyba to nie jest tak naprawdę [i]zamknięte na klucz,[/i] bardziej jak - [i]zamknięte.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Could - [i]anyone[/i] - turn that wheel?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Czy - [i]każdy[/i] - mógłby obrócić to koło?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Probably not, it takes some upper body strength.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Chyba nie, to wymaga trochę siły w rękach i barkach.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Hm.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Hm.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Let me guess. Nobody.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Zgadnę. Nikt.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Uh - uh...
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Yy - yy...
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Was it a [h]person?[/h]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Czy to była [h]osoba?[/h]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I dunno, maybe. It was dark, I could only really make out the eyes-
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Nie wiem, może. Było ciemno, mogłam naprawdę dojrzeć tylko oczy-
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: -and it wasn't [i]looking[/i] at me, it was looking out to the side - at the ocean, I guess?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: -i nie [i]patrzyło[/i] to na mnie, patrzyło gdzieś w bok - na ocean, tak sądzę?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Then it starts talking.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Potem zaczyna mówić.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: ...what did it [i]say?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: ...co to [i]powiedziało?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en:
Ali-
[i]What??[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl:
Obc-
[i]Co??[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Okay, even [i]I'm[/i] making notes now. This is the best statement we ever got.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Okej, nawet [i]ja[/i] teraz robię notatki. To najlepsze zeznanie, jakie kiedykolwiek dostaliśmy.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: It can't be anything [i]good[/i], I figure. Better put a stop to it.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: To nie może być nic [i]dobrego,[/i] pomyślałam. Lepiej to powstrzymać.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: [i]Suspect - vanquishes - demon - with - improvised - javelin.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: [i]Podejrzana - pokonuje - demona - improwizowanym - oszczepem.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Direct hit. Its [i]head[/i] came off, pretty sure - I saw it fall into the ocean.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Trafienie w punkt. Jej [i]głowa[/i] odpadła, jestem raczej pewna - widziałam, jak wpada do oceanu.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: After that, the green glow went away, so now it's too dark to see anything.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Po tym zielona poświata zniknęła, więc teraz jest zbyt ciemno, żeby cokolwiek zobaczyć.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Uh, no. Not - no.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Yy, nie. Nie - nie.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I'm pretty sure I was being [i]watched.[/i] Like I could feel - [i]something[/i] was out there with me.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Jestem raczej pewna, że byłam [i]obserwowana.[/i] Jakbym czuła - że [i]coś[/i] tam było ze mną.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: How should I [i]put[/i] this-
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Jak by to [i]ująć[/i]-
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Oh, [i]yeah[/i]. I did, actually - it was right there, floating in the water.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: O, [i]tak.[/i] Właściwie tak - było tuż tam, unosiło się na wodzie.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Turns out it was this, uh... this leather [i]mask[/i] kinda thing?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Okazało się, że to było coś takiego, yy... coś jak skórzana [i]maska?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: A [i]mask...?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: [i]Maska...?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Like a [i]full head[/i] mask, you know, kinda like a balaclava.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Taka maska na [i]całą głowę,[/i] no wiecie, coś jak kominiarka.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Do you still [i]have[/i] it??
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Nadal ją [i]masz?[/i]?
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: It's gone. I think it got stolen.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Zniknęła. Chyba została skradziona.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: -that's, uh... [i]disappointing.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: -to, yy... [i]rozczarowujące.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: Tadpole, you didn't finish your statement.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Tadpole, nie skończyłaś swojego zeznania.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: [i]Right[/i], right.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: [i]Racja,[/i] racja.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: That's it - story's over, get out of here!
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: To wszystko - koniec historii, wynocha stąd!
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: I dunno. Sorry.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Nie wiem. Wybaczcie.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.en: By turning the wheel.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.pl: Obracając kołem.
Conversation/Tadpole 04 STATEMENT/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole
